comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Thanks. As it turns out, the recipe for this dress comes from the Earl of Leicester and not the Young Woman as shown; she has an entirely different recipe. This sewing recipe is available during World Clock, 16th Century's phase 5, and 17th Century's phases 1 and 2.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock/item
Images: japaneseteacom2.blog21.fc2.com/blog-entry-807.html

Its stats are:

+1 Metal trading
+1 Merchandise Knowledge
female-only
8k total fame to equip

World Clock is 17-2 period as of this comment, so it'll be accessible until next World Clock shift, at the very least, and can be accessed at any time if you have the appropriate Adept of Ages chrono-quest title equipped, or if you own and equip some pricey alchemy-based EX equipment with the 16th/17th Century effect imbued into it.

comments.author: Rufas
comments.body: I went to make this today and while the dress made at the Earl of Leicester in the given chrono period is indeed "English Dress" with that model and boosts, it is a different colour (yellowy) and requires 80 cotton fabric, not 30.
